name: Magnolia Outfitters
summary: Magnolia Outfitters is a specialty western and outdoor lifestyle retail destination on FM 1488 in Magnolia, Texas. Serving the equestrian and rural community of Montgomery County, this highly-rated outfitter offers country lifestyle products and accessories for ranchers and outdoor enthusiasts.
demographics: Magnolia Outfitters serves the growing suburban community of Magnolia, Texas, attracting middle to upper-middle income families and rural residents in the FM 1488 corridor. The primary trade area consists of homeowners aged 35-65 with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000, including ranchers, equestrian enthusiasts, and outdoor recreation seekers. Visitors typically seek specialized western wear, outdoor gear, and country lifestyle products, with shopping patterns reflecting both practical ranch needs and leisure activities common to the Texas Hill Country region.
description: Magnolia Outfitters is a specialty retail destination located on Farm to Market Road 1488 in Magnolia, Texas, serving the western and outdoor lifestyle needs of the greater Montgomery County area. This unique shopping location caters to the region's strong equestrian and rural heritage, offering products and services tailored to ranchers, horse enthusiasts, and outdoor recreation lovers. The center maintains a strong reputation in the community with a 4.8-star rating, reflecting its commitment to quality merchandise and customer service. Operating daily from 11:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Magnolia Outfitters provides a convenient shopping experience for residents of this rapidly growing suburban area northwest of Houston. The location's connection to TX Diamonds Boutique suggests a curated selection of western jewelry and accessories alongside traditional outfitter merchandise, creating a distinctive retail experience that celebrates Texas country living.
